issues.problem: Unit/scale mismatch. The heading says 'Amounts in thousands of euros (EUR '000)', but the workbook is in euros and the statements print the euro amounts unchanged. Every figure is therefore overstated 1,000 times as labelled. For example, revenue reads as EUR 21.2 billion instead of EUR 21.2 million. Either divide all amounts by 1,000 or change the unit in the heading to euros.
issues.evidence: Workbook headers: CR!A2 'Compte de résultat ... (en euros)', 'Bilan actif'!A2 '(en euros)', 'Bilan passif'!A2 '(en euros)', TFT!A1 '(en euros)'. CR!B5 '21 154 756' is printed as Revenue 21,154,756 under the EUR '000 heading. 'Bilan actif'!D19 '10 587 466' is printed as Total assets 10,587,466.
